arxiv-2112-12612.title: Towards Disturbance-Free Visual Mobile Manipulation
arxiv-2112-12612.creator: Tianwei Ni, Kiana Ehsani, Luca Weihs, Jordi Salvador
arxiv-2112-12612.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning has shown promising results on an abundance of robotic tasks in simulation, including visual navigation and manipulation. Prior work generally aims to build embodied agents that solve their assigned tasks as quickly as possible, while largely ignoring the problems caused by collision with objects during interaction.

arxiv-2208-10915.title: Coupled Channel Effects for the Charmed-Strange Mesons
arxiv-2208-10915.creator: Wei Hao, Yu Lu, Bing-Song Zou
arxiv-2208-10915.description: Abstract We make a systematic calculation of the spectra and hadronic decays of the D s D_{s} system in a coupled channel framework, where the unquenched effects are induced by the P 0 3 {}^{3}P_{0} model. In the calculation, the wave functions are obtained by using a nonrelativistic potential model and are handled precisely with Gaussian Expansion Method.

arxiv-2209-02823.title: Linear potentials and applications in conformal geometry
arxiv-2209-02823.creator: Shiguang Ma
arxiv-2209-02823.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shiguang Ma. In this paper we derive estimates for linear potentials that hold away from thin subsets. And, inspired by the celebrated work of Huber (cf. [ 16 , 22 ] ), we verify that, for a subset that is thin at a point, there is always a geodesic that reaches to the point and avoids the thin subset in general dimensions.

arxiv-2405-02771.title: MMEarth: Exploring Multi-Modal Pretext Tasks For Geospatial Representation Learning
arxiv-2405-02771.creator: Vishal Nedungadi, Ankit Kariryaa, Stefan Oehmcke, Serge Belongie, Christian Igel, Nico Lang
arxiv-2405-02771.description: Abstract The volume of unlabelled Earth observation (EO) data is huge, but many important applications lack labelled training data. However, EO data offers the unique opportunity to pair data from different modalities and sensors automatically based on geographic location and time, at virtually no human labor cost.

pmc-10648491.title: Association of GSTM1 Polymorphism and Redox Potential with Idiopathic Male Infertility
pmc-10648491.creator: Anastasios Potiris, Anastasia Voitse, Despoina Mavrogianni, Nikolaos Machairiotis, Eirini Drakaki, Myrto Papamentzelopoulou, Theodoros Karampitsakos, Athanasios Zikopoulos, Evangelini Evgeni, Peter Drakakis, Sofoklis Stavros, Willem Ombelet
pmc-10648491.description: Background: The aim of this case–control study is to investigate possible associations between GSTM1 polymorphism and redox potential with sperm parameters. Methods: The study group consisted of sperm samples from 51 infertile men according to the WHO guidelines. The control group included 39 samples from men with normal seminal parameters.

pmc-10674504.title: Associations of Long-Term Exposure to PM2.5 and Its Constituents with Erythrocytosis and Thrombocytosis in Rural Populations
pmc-10674504.creator: Yiquan Zheng, Yaling He, Ning Kang, Caiyun Zhang, Wei Liao, Yinghao Yuchi, Xiaotian Liu, Jian Hou, Zhenxing Mao, Wenqian Huo, Kai Zhang, Hezhong Tian, Hualiang Lin, Chongjian Wang, Alexander Larcombe
pmc-10674504.description: Evidence on the effect of long-term exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) on erythrocytosis and thrombocytosis prevalence was limited. We aimed to investigate the association of PM2.5 and its constituents with the risks of erythrocytosis and thrombocytosis. The present study included a total of 33,585 participants from the Henan Rural Cohort at baseline between 2015 and 2017.

pmc-11401899.title: PARylation of 14-3-3 proteins controls the virulence of Magnaporthe oryzae
pmc-11401899.creator: Xiuqin Gao, Gaigai Gao, Weifeng Zheng, Haibing Liu, Wenbo Pan, Xi Xia, Dongmei Zhang, Wenwei Lin, Zonghua Wang, Baomin Feng
pmc-11401899.description: Magnaporthe oryzae is a devastating fungal pathogen that causes the rice blast disease worldwide. The post-translational modification of ADP-ribosylation holds significant importance in various fundamental biological processes. However, the specific function of this modification in M. oryzae remains unknown. This study revealed that Poly(ADP-ribosyl)ation (PARylation) executes a critical function in M. oryzae. M.

pmc-11470886.title: Spectral Networks and Stability Conditions for Fukaya Categories with Coefficients
pmc-11470886.creator: F. Haiden, L. Katzarkov, C. Simpson
pmc-11470886.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Given a holomorphic family of Bridgeland stability conditions over a surface, we define a notion of spectral network which is an object in a Fukaya category of the surface with coefficients in a triangulated DG-category. These spectral networks are analogs of special Lagrangian submanifolds, combining a graph with additional algebraic data, and conjecturally correspond to semistable objects of a suitable stability condition on the Fukaya category with coefficients. They are closely related to the spectral networks of Gaiotto–Moore–Neitzke.

pmc-11484948.title: A harmonized data set of ruminant livestock presence and grazing data for the European Union and neighbouring countries
pmc-11484948.creator: Žiga Malek, Zoriana Romanchuk, Orysia Yashchun, Linda See
pmc-11484948.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Improving the sustainability of the European livestock sector requires recent data at high spatial resolutions. Only then can we analyse potential negative impacts of livestock related to ecosystem degradation, and positive ones such as preserving cultural landscapes through grazing. Data on livestock numbers in Europe are provided by the European statistical office but at a coarse spatial resolution aggregated to statistical regions like NUTS2 or even coarser.

pmc-11497218.title: Structure properties and industrial applications of anion exchange resins for the removal of electroactive nitrate ions from contaminated water
pmc-11497218.creator: Mohammad Faraz Ahmer, Mohammad Kashif Uddin
pmc-11497218.description: The presence of nitrates in lakes, rivers, and groundwater is common. Anion exchange resins (AER) are polymeric structures that contain functional groups as well as a variety of particle sizes that are used for removing nitrate ions from solutions. This article provides a concise review of the types and properties of AER, synthesis methods, characterization, and environmental applications of AER.

pmc-11599538.title: Multidrug resistance in Pseudomonas aeruginosa: genetic control mechanisms and therapeutic advances
pmc-11599538.creator: Yuanjing Zhao, Haoran Xu, Hui Wang, Ping Wang, Simin Chen
pmc-11599538.description: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a significant opportunistic pathogen, and its complex mechanisms of antibiotic resistance pose a challenge to modern medicine. This literature review explores the advancements made from 1979 to 2024 in understanding the regulatory networks of antibiotic resistance genes in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, with a particular focus on the molecular underpinnings of these resistance mechanisms.

pmc-12702269.title: Clinical Impact of Mepolizumab on Airway Mucus Plugs in Patients with Severe Asthma
pmc-12702269.creator: Yu Hara, Naoya Tanabe, Satoshi Marumo, Kota Murohashi, Yusuke Hayashi, Mayu Nagata, Takuji Asada, Satoshi Nagaoka, Nobuaki Kobayashi, Toyohiro Hirai, Takeshi Kaneko
pmc-12702269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeAirway mucus plugs are driven by eosinophilic inflammation and considered an important treatable trait in severe asthma. However, whether mepolizumab, an antibody that suppresses the interleukin-5 pathway and eosinophilic inflammation, can remove mucus plugs remains unclear.

pmc-12735780.title: The Role of Vitamin D in Parkinson’s Disease: Evidence from Serum Concentrations, Supplementation, and VDR Gene Polymorphisms
pmc-12735780.creator: Jamir Pitton Rissardo, Ana Leticia Fornari Caprara
pmc-12735780.description: Background/aim: Vitamin D (VitD) has been implicated in neuroprotection, yet its role in Parkinson’s disease (PD) remains unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between VitD status, supplementation, and vitamin D receptor (VDR) gene polymorphisms with PD risk and outcomes.

pmc-13014855.title: Challenging case of bacterial meningitis due to Moraxella osloensis diagnosed by 16s rRNA sequencing
pmc-13014855.creator: Sreethish Sasi, Manal Hamed, Faiha Eltayeb, Andrez Perez-Lopez, Muna Al-Maslamani, Mohamed Abukhattab
pmc-13014855.description: IntroductionMoraxella osloensis is a rare, Gram-negative, oxidase-positive coccobacillus that is infrequently identified as a pathogen in clinical diseases. It is usually opportunistic and associated with an immunocompromised host or the presence of invasive medical devices. Central nervous system infections caused by M. osloensis are extremely uncommon, with only a few cases documented in the literature.

pmc-13305625.title: P22 Evaluating the impact of antimicrobial pharmacist and consultant microbiologist–led AMS ward rounds at York and Scarborough Teaching Hospital
pmc-13305625.creator: Ammara Asif, Barry Neish, Chris Beard, Dave Hamilton, Damian Mawer, Katrina Blackmore, Mathew Heaney, Heather Mackenzie, Paul Jackson, David Preece, Rachel Phillips, Rebecca Ince
pmc-13305625.description: BackgroundIncreasing antimicrobial resistance is a global threat, highlighting the need for robust antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) practices. Pharmacists and pharmacy technicians are integral members of AMS teams, and joint ward rounds with consultant microbiologists provide an important forum to optimize antibiotic use and improve patient care.

The present study aimed to evaluate morphological diversity and phenotypic variation of M.

pmc-13360813.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare: Automation Bias, Deskilling, and Cognitive Implications – A Systematic Review
pmc-13360813.creator: Fahad M Al-Anezi
pmc-13360813.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundGenerative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly transforming eHealthcare, promising substantial gains in diagnostic accuracy, workflow efficiency, and decision support, yet raising concerns about automation bias and clinician deskilling that may erode core diagnostic expertise and professional judgment over time.Aim and ObjectivesThis systematic review investigates the dual impact of GenAI in eHealthcare, focusing on how it enhances clinical efficiency and decision support while potentially diminishing clinicians’ diagnostic expertise and professional judgment.MethodsA systematic search was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google

pmc-13563674.title: scASprofiler: profiling single-cell RNA splicing with a deep convolutional generative network
pmc-13563674.creator: Pengwei Hu, Pengcheng Song, Bingjie Dai, Chunshen Long, Hanshuang Li, Yongchun Zuo, Yongqiang Xing
pmc-13563674.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables the investigation of alternative splicing (AS) at cellular resolution. However, the analysis of AS in scRNA-seq data is constrained by sparse splice-junction coverage, a consequence of low sequencing depth per cell. This limitation is particularly pronounced in 3′-biased, droplet-based protocols.
